เมื่อได้รับใบผลตรวจสุขภาพประจำปี ตารางกา: When you receive your annual health check-up results, the blood lipid table (Lipid Panel or Lipid Profile) is often one of the sections that attracts the most attention. However, the complexity of medical abbreviations and the numbers in each box can cause considerable confusion. Correctly understanding the meaning of each type of lipid value helps us assess the health of our blood vessels and plan our self-care more effectively

แม้คอเลสเตอรอลจะเป็นสารจำเป็นที่ร่างกายใ: Although cholesterol is an essential substance the body uses to build cells, hormones and bile acids, looking at total cholesterol alone may not clearly indicate the risk to blood vessel health, because the proportions of each type of lipid must also be considered
ไตรกลีเซอไรด์คือ ไขมันชนิดหนึ่งที่ร่างกา: Triglycerides are a type of fat the body makes from excess energy obtained from food, especially carbohydrates, processed starches, sugar and alcohol. When the body does not use up all this energy, it converts it into triglycerides and stores them in fat cells. Having blood triglyceride levels above the recommended range is associated with blood vessel elasticity and insulin resistance
HDL มักถูกเรียกว่า \"ไขมันชนิดดี\" ทำหน้: HDL is often called "good cholesterol". It acts like a vehicle that cleans the blood vessels, capturing excess cholesterol left on the blood vessel walls and transporting it back to be broken down and eliminated from the body via the liver. Having HDL at an appropriate level therefore plays an important role in supporting a strong circulatory system
LDL มักถูกเรียกว่า \"ไขมันชนิดไม่ดี\" ทำ: LDL is often called "bad cholesterol". It transports cholesterol from the liver to cells throughout the body. If there is more LDL in the bloodstream than needed, this cholesterol may undergo oxidation and accumulate on the blood vessel walls, leading to plaque build-up and reduced blood vessel elasticity over the long term

การรักษาความสมดุลของระดับไขมันในเลือดต้อ: Maintaining balanced blood lipid levels requires systematic changes to daily behaviour, including:
การออกกำลังกายแบบแอโรบิกอย่างน้อย 150 นา: Aerobic exercise for at least 150 minutes per week helps stimulate enzymes that help raise HDL levels and lower triglyceride levels
ภาวะเครียดเรื้อรังและการนอนหลับไม่เพียงพ: Chronic stress and insufficient sleep stimulate the release of the hormone cortisol, which affects the liver's synthesis of lipids
ลดกรดไขมันอิ่มตัวและไขมันทรานส์ เพิ่มการ: Reduce saturated fatty acids and trans fats, and eat more unsaturated fatty acids and antioxidants, which play a role in protecting cells from oxidation
